## Gap ID
GAP-001 / API-009 (duplicate)

## Source
gap-analysis-feature-parity, gap-analysis-api-interface

## Description
OSimFlow is CLI-only with no graphical UI. openstudio-server's PAT (Parametric Analysis Tool) provides a full web GUI for:
- Analysis setup and configuration
- Measure selection and ordering
- Variable definition and distribution selection
- Results visualization
- Analysis management

## Evidence
- No web UI code in `osimflow/`
- AGENTS.md §0.2 confirms CLI + library hybrid

## Severity
Critical

## Recommended Mitigation
This is a significant undertaking. Priority order:
1. Basic analysis setup UI (measure/variable configuration)
2. Results visualization dashboard
3. Real-time progress tracking

Note: This may be out of scope for MVP replacement but is critical for user experience parity.

## Labels
gap-analysis, ui, pat, web, critical
